criteria.description: AgentEventKind.failed end-to-end support across models, monitor, and adapters
criteria.notes: Failed event is correctly dispatched, updates active popup, and cleans up active session.

criteria.description: Failure speech bubble styling with crimson background, red border, and 6s auto-dismiss
criteria.notes: SpeechBubbleView renders crimson styling and sets autoDismissDelay to 6s.

criteria.description: Paw-tap attention cue on .needsApproval using out-of-process CoreAnimation
criteria.notes: CALayerMotionBridge applies pawTap animation with 3pt amplitude and 0.22s half-period at 0% CPU.

criteria.description: Quick-action HUD: Jump to Terminal via AppActivating protocol seam
criteria.notes: WorkspaceAppActivator brings target application forward without stealing keyboard focus.

criteria.description: Quick-action HUD: View Diff via DiffViewing protocol seam
criteria.notes: SystemDiffViewer spawns git diff off the main thread.

criteria.description: Safe hook-based approval channel dispatching single-use decision without keystroke injection
criteria.notes: Decisions write directly to explicit response channels and never use synthetic typing.

criteria.description: Approval token store managing single-use consumption and automatic TTL expiry
criteria.notes: Single-use invalidation prevents double approvals; expired tokens reject approval.

criteria.description: Interactive bubble window click routing while maintaining mascot overlay click-through
criteria.notes: SpeechBubblePanel enables mouse clicks when buttons are visible and reverts to click-through.
